title: Abuse Policy
subtitle: This service is provided for legitimate file sharing purposes.

prohibited.title: Prohibited content
prohibited.intro: The following are not permitted on this service:
items: Illegal content as defined by applicable law
Malware, viruses, or other malicious software
Anything intended to harm or exploit others

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.body: Violations will result in immediate file removal and may be reported to the appropriate authorities. Repeated or severe violations may result in the originating IP address being blocked.

reporting.title: Reporting abuse
reporting.body: To report abusive content, contact the server administrator. Abuse reports are investigated and acted upon promptly.
